notes: Astrophysical bound (not DM haloscope) from NuSTAR observations of the starburst galaxy M82, constraining axion-photon coupling for radiatively decaying axions with masses ~30-500 keV. Benchmark stated in text: ma=316 keV, g12=0.75 (i.e. gaγ=7.5e-13 GeV^-1). Bound reaches gaγ ~ 10^-12-10^-10 GeV^-1. Data points approximated from Fig. 2 exclusion contour and the quoted benchmark; the '30 keV' and '500 keV' endpoints are rougher estimates. No local DM density since this is a stellar/astrophysical production+decay bound.
